evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows'; changes CMakeLists.txt, cmake modules, and CI workflows to switch native Windows builds from cl.exe to clang-cl.
rationale: Transitioning native Windows builds to clang-cl cuts CI times by 38% and resolves multiple recurring MSVC compiler bugs and workarounds. Author microbenchmarks show substantial validation performance gains on Windows (e.g., ConnectBlockAllEcdsa up ~55%), and reviewers note it enables better codegen and future assembly optimizations.
